#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Configure the reading-group@local.edu mailing list.

Idempotent: run as the `list` user after `mailman create`.  Sets the policies
the reading group asked for:

  * joining via reading-group-join@  -> subscribe, user confirms, no moderator
  * leaving via reading-group-leave@ -> unsubscribe, user confirms, no moderator
  * posting to reading-group@        -> accepted from members and non-members
                                       (no owner/moderator approval)
"""

from mailman.core.initialize import initialize
from mailman.database.transaction import transactional
from mailman.interfaces.action import Action
from mailman.interfaces.listmanager import IListManager
from mailman.interfaces.mailinglist import SubscriptionPolicy
from zope.component import getUtility

CONFIG = '/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg'
LIST = 'reading-group@local.edu'


@transactional
def configure(mlist):
    # Users must reply to a confirmation message (SubscriptionPolicy.confirm);
    # the list owner never has to approve a join or leave request.
    mlist.subscription_policy = SubscriptionPolicy.confirm
    mlist.unsubscription_policy = SubscriptionPolicy.confirm
    # Posts are accepted immediately; nothing is held for moderation.
    mlist.default_member_action = Action.accept
    mlist.default_nonmember_action = Action.accept
    # No digests, no admin notifications for routine traffic.
    mlist.digests_enabled = False
    mlist.digest_is_default = False
    mlist.admin_immed_notify = False
    mlist.send_welcome_message = True
    mlist.display_name = 'Reading Group'
    mlist.description = 'Reading group announcements.'

    print('list:                  ', mlist.fqdn_listname)
    print('subscription_policy:   ', mlist.subscription_policy)
    print('unsubscription_policy: ', mlist.unsubscription_policy)
    print('default_member_action: ', mlist.default_member_action)
    print('default_nonmember_action:', mlist.default_nonmember_action)


def main():
    initialize(CONFIG)
    mlist = getUtility(IListManager).get(LIST)
    if mlist is None:
        raise SystemExit('{} does not exist; run `mailman create` first'.format(LIST))
    configure(mlist)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Mailing list server: reading-group@local.edu

Postfix + GNU Mailman 3, talking over LMTP.  All configuration was applied to
this machine; the scripts below are committed only so the state is
reproducible.

## Addresses

| Address | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `reading-group@local.edu` | Post an announcement; delivered to every subscriber. |
| `reading-group-join@local.edu` | Request to join.  The user replies to the confirmation mail (`reading-group-confirm+<token>@local.edu`) and is then subscribed. No owner approval. |
| `reading-group-leave@local.edu` | Request to leave.  Same confirmation reply, then unsubscribed. No owner approval. |
| `reading-group-request@local.edu` | Mail command robot (`help`, `confirm <token>`, `join`, `leave`, ...). |
| `reading-group-owner@local.edu` | List owner (`root@local.edu`). |

User mailboxes are plain mbox files at `/var/mail/<unix-user>`.

## Message flow

```
smtp :25 (postfix)
  └─ transport_maps=hash:/var/lib/mailman3/data/postfix_lmtp
       └─ reading-group*@local.edu → lmtp:127.0.0.1:8024 (mailman3)
            └─ mailman3 → smtp:localhost:25 (postfix) → /var/mail/<user>
```

`local.edu` is in both `mydestination` and `relay_domains`, so ordinary users
keep their normal local mailboxes while the list addresses are routed away by
the transport map, which postfix checks before local delivery.

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/etc/mailman3/mailman.cfg` | Mailman configuration (Debian layout, SQLite, LMTP in on 8024, SMTP out on 25). |
| `/var/lib/mailman3/data/mailman.db` | Mailman database (list, members, pending confirmations). |
| `/var/lib/mailman3/data/postfix_lmtp{,.db}` | Generated LMTP transport map; regenerate with `mailman aliases` + `postmap`. |
| `/usr/local/sbin/mailservers-setup` | Idempotent provisioning (postfix settings, list creation, policies, maps). |
| `/usr/local/sbin/setup-reading-group-list.py` | List policies: subscription/unsubscription = `confirm`, member & non-member actions = `accept`. |
| `/usr/local/sbin/mailservers-start` | Start postfix + mailman3 if not running (boot hook, `.bashrc`, `/etc/rc.local`). |

## Policies

* `subscription_policy = confirm` — the subscriber must reply to the
  confirmation mail; the list owner never has to approve.  (Not `open`:
  `open` subscribes without any confirmation at all, which contradicts the
  "after confirmation" requirement.)
* `unsubscription_policy = confirm` — same for leaving.
* `default_member_action` / `default_nonmember_action = accept` — posts are
  never held for moderation.
